opinion_bands.label: No material exposure identified
opinion_bands.definition: Weighted risk is at or below 5% of applicable controls, and no Critical-severity finding was confirmed.

opinion_bands.label: Exposure identified with findings
opinion_bands.definition: Weighted risk is between 5% and 30% of applicable controls, or a Critical-severity finding was confirmed at low overall weighted risk.

opinion_bands.label: Material exposure identified
opinion_bands.definition: Weighted risk exceeds 30% of applicable controls, or any Critical-severity finding was confirmed.

controls.title: No SBOM component matches a known, actively exploited vulnerability
controls.obligation: Third-party and open-weight model and library dependencies are inventoried and free of known, actively exploited vulnerabilities.
controls.logic: Match each SBOM package/version against the warehouse vulnerability set by purl and version range.
controls.finding_template: One or more components in {client}'s software bill of materials carry a vulnerability with confirmed exploitation in the wild.

controls.title: Every agent tool holds the minimum scope its function requires
controls.obligation: Agent tools are scoped to least privilege rather than broad or administrative access.
controls.logic: Every declared agent tool has least_privilege = true in the agent tool manifest.
controls.finding_template: One or more agent tools declared by {client} hold broader scope than their function requires.

controls.title: Retrieval enforces tenant isolation at query time
controls.obligation: Vector stores serving more than one tenant filter retrieval results by tenant or principal at query time.
controls.logic: Every declared vector store has tenant_isolation = true.
controls.finding_template: One or more vector stores declared by {client} do not enforce tenant isolation at query time.

controls.title: System prompts contain no secrets
controls.obligation: System prompts hold no credentials, API keys, or security-relevant logic that would matter if disclosed.
controls.logic: No entry in the system prompt library is flagged contains_secret.
controls.finding_template: One or more system prompts declared by {client} are flagged as containing a secret.

controls.title: AI incidents have a defined response path and named owner
controls.obligation: There is a documented, owned incident response path specific to AI system failures and misuse.
controls.logic: Unstructured evidence (policy documents) reviewed by the auditor; no declarative rule applies.
controls.finding_template: {client} did not provide evidence of a documented AI incident response path with a named owner.
